title: Breakfast with Santa
seo_title: Breakfast with Santa at The Worman House, Nov 29
description: Breakfast with Santa is a morning meal at The Worman House where you can have your photo taken with St. Nick. The food includes an omelet station, a festive cupcake wall, Belgian waffles, French toast, and more. It takes place Sunday, November 29, 2026, from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM at Worman House.
